LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 5.1.1 LISTENING COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.1: Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Listening Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Listening Comprehension, part of Strand 5 in Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why should we pronounce sounds correctly? 2. Which words do we use to describe things, people or events?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to a speech and pick out words containing sound /e/,

2. interpret non-verbal cues such as gestures, facial expressions and eye contact collaboratively with peers,

3. prepare and make a speech while collaborating with peers, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to a speech and pick out words containing sound /e/,
2. interpret non-verbal cues such as gestures, facial expressions and eye contact collaboratively with peers,
3. prepare and make a speech while collaborating with peers, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Listening Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship is inculcated as the learner discusses and appreciates traditional foods from different communities.

• Self-efficacy is enhanced as the learner’s confidence is enhanced as they recite poems and make speeches while

collaborating with peers.

Values:
Patriotism is developed as the learner shows awareness of own culture and respect for others’ culture as they listen to

poems describing traditional foods.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Cultural awareness: This is promoted as the learner interacts with texts on traditional foods.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner applies the skill of listening comprehension in all other learning areas as they all require listening skills as a

learning prerequisite.
